start: ^You stand at the mouth of a cave. Cold air drifts out of the dark.
^A torch bracket juts from the wall beside you.

b: ^Your torch throws light across the walls.

light_torch: ^You strike a spark. The torch catches and flares to life.

b:
^The torchlight reveals a carved stairway leading down.

^You descend with steady footing.

^You feel your way forward in the dark, one hand on the wall.

^Something crunches underfoot. Best not to look.

ending: ^The passage opens into a wide chamber. Your adventure begins here.
